summary: We designed a web-based video game for students who want to learn about mission design in an engaging, fun, and interactive way without taking a class or reading through challenging chapters in a book. Our project guides players through a role-playing game that covers key considerations, including mission objectives, spacecraft design, scientific instruments, launch, budget, power, orbital constraints, and communications, by giving them responsibilities as a commander, engineer, pilot, and crew member while teaching them how to take on these responsibilities in a fun way. This kind of engaging digital product is important for students who want to learn about space but find traditional learning in this field difficult. Students today mostly grew up playing video games and learning interactively rather than only reading books. Our objective, therefore, is to make basic space mission education accessible and adaptable for the younger generation and to motivate them to pursue careers in this field, leading to even more technological development and revolution in the future.
details:
Our Project is an interactive space mission game that teaches players how to balance fuel, mass, thrust, altitude, mission duration, and cost to create successful missions. 

Through hands-on decision-making and real-world trade-offs, players gain a deeper understanding of the challenges faced by mission planners and aerospace engineers.

We used HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to create a browser-based game for ease of access. We wanted to make it a realistic and human-feeling experience, so we spent quite a few hours coding most of the base before using AI to improve the experience rather than having AI make the whole experience.
